name: Aguas Cándidas (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, blue and green, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Aguas Cándidas (a bridge on blue, a castle and a cross of Saint James, above waves).
history: Municipal flag of Aguas Cándidas; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Aguas Cándidas arms — bridge, castle and cross above waves
